stem: Which model is shaded to represent the quotient of \( \frac{1}{3} \div 4 \)?

options.label: A
options.text: A model divided into three rows; the bottom row is divided into 4 equal parts with the last part shaded gray.

options.label: B
options.text: A 3 by 4 grid with 3 boxes shaded gray in the bottom row.

options.label: C
options.text: A model divided into 4 rows; the bottom row is divided into 4 equal parts with the last part shaded gray.

options.label: D
options.text: A 4 by 4 grid with 4 boxes shaded gray in the bottom row.
